notes_for_us: Close two-genre call resolved as one: the loop is a scavenger hunt, which is Adventure in the index, but the Animal Sim preset already carries the wilderness shape and the second genre would only have added a trail and a hidden alcove. Naming Adventure is free and I still did not, because the shape and preset both came from Roleplay - the skill says name it regardless, and I would like a clearer line on when the free naming is actually required.

Scale hits the hide-and-seek trap head on. The smallest thing that matters is a single shell at crab height, which is Room, but a beach to wander is not a room - and the skill only names the trap for hide-and-seek without saying which way a first-person-scale animal sim resolves.

The crab is the subject of the sentence and there is nowhere to put it. Same hole as the sphere players two prompts earlier: the avatar is the thing the user is most specific about and the handoff has no field for it.
